description: Clearest at its strongest: early game, I am the first player (even ply), the opponent's stones sit on the bottom corners (0,0) and/or (0,6) (also (0,1)), and my stones hold the bottom center, with column 3 free of opponent stones (an opponent stone at (1,3) or on my center stone turns it off). Most threshold-level firing is in the middle game and fits no simple board rule; treat this as a partial, low-confidence description.
effect: Almost none at ordinary activations (move probabilities change by <=0.06). At extreme activation (12-13), zeroing it raises column 3 by about 20 points and lowers column 4 by 11-15 points, so strong activation moves probability from the center column to column 4.
notes: 7 of 8 score calls used. Best F1 0.179 (p3 weighted corner/parity/center rule, AUROC 0.61, sim share 0.08). '(1,3) is mine' has AUROC 0.68 but fires on 33% of positions. Ruled out: engine eval, live-window advantage (AUROC 0.53), last-move column. Top activations are clean and parity-sensitive (adding one move drops 12 to ~0), but midgame firing is unexplained, so this may be a mixture or random direction. Synthesis reaches 13.10 > dev max 12.735.
